phrases.note: Greek uses ; as its question mark.
First form if you're male, second if you're female.
Use with strangers and older people. With friends: Γεια σου (ya sou).
Ναι (ne) means yes, which catches many newcomers out.

phrases.en: Please take me to this address
phrases.local: Πηγαίνετέ με σε αυτή τη διεύθυνση, παρακαλώ.
phrases.tr: Pigénete me se aftí ti diéfthinsi, parakaló.

phrases.note: Order coffee by sweetness: σκέτο (none), μέτριο (medium), γλυκό (sweet).
